title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
human hepatocyte regeneration
its proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1 (SERPINE1)
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract labels PAI1 as senescence-inducing but does not state that a senescent state is measured, induced, reversed, or compared; it also uses only a generic multi-omics label without naming currently used molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical study in primary human hepatocytes. Aging relevance is unresolved rather than established because the reported analysis focuses on hepatocyte regeneration and proliferation, while cellular senescence is only invoked through a target modifier. The generic multi-omics label does not support enumerating distinct omics layers.
